children.text: Nava Hatha Yoga is dedicated to offering Classical Hatha Yoga with sincerity and respect for the tradition. Classes are held in person in Saranda, Albania, and are open to both beginners and committed practitioners.

hero.headline: Classical Hatha Yoga
hero.supportingText: “Hatha Yoga is not body-bending business. It is about taking charge of the way you think, feel, and perceive life.” ― Sadhguru

children.text: Classical Hatha Yoga stems from a deep understanding of the mechanics of the body, and uses yogic postures, or yogasanas, to enable the system to sustain higher dimensions of energy. By practicing this profound science, one can change and enhance the way they think, feel, and experience life.
Classical Hatha Yoga is about creating a body that is not a hurdle in your life. The body becomes a stepping stone in the progress towards blossoming into your ultimate possibility.

Private and corporate sessions are available upon request. Depending on the needs of the individual, group, or organization, selected Classical Hatha Yoga practices can be offered in a focused setting.
